why: `claim_tag` is `type: claim`, and an ordering is defined on `date` and `number` and on nothing else (contract 0.26.0). `query` refuses `concept[claim_tag>open]` as `unordered-property`, and this is the same refusal through `retrieve`'s `where`: a server that compared the text anyway would return rows, and one that never parsed the ordering operators would say `parse`. Neither is this code. It also pins that a `where` is typechecked against the corpus and not merely parsed — the text is well-formed and still refused.
